youtube.baslik: Does every positional vertigo get a repositioning maneuver? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The success of a repositioning maneuver depends on an accurate diagnosis. If the nystagmus does not fit typical BPPV, for example if it has no latency, does not fatigue, or is purely downbeating, no maneuver is done; the findings are recorded and the patient is referred for physician evaluation. Downbeating positional nystagmus can also have central causes.
